The raw_customers table is an SCD2 dimension. It has 230 rows for 200 distinct customers: 200 rows with is_current=True and 30 historical rows with is_current=False. The join in silver_customers keeps both, so the 30 customers with history are duplicated in gold_region_daily. That explains 5286 vs 4600.

The fix is to keep only current rows in silver_customers. Every customer has exactly one current row (200 current rows, 200 distinct customers), so filtering on is_current = True gives one row per customer.

The historical rows have valid_from 2023-06-01 and the current rows have 2025-01-01. All transactions are from January 2026, so the current row is the right one for every transaction. I can't see the valid_to column, but the current-row filter is unambiguous.

The other gold tables use silver_transactions or silver_merchants and are not affected. Merchants are unique, with 40 rows and 40 distinct IDs.

The step keeps the same columns, customer_id and region.
